predecessor.activation_rule: Pass 214 implementation and final merge must inherit the authoritative Pass 213 closure commit or an explicit superseding cumulative predecessor.

purpose: Measure the real operating distribution, storage cost, recovery behavior, and transition dynamics of the Pass 212 three-tier compression gradient across actual HHS workloads without converting reference-vector ceilings into unmeasured operating claims.

tier_1_generator.admission: The entire hydration is regenerated from an admitted canonical generator witness and exact seed material.
tier_1_generator.storage: Seed, generator/domain witness, manifests, roots, receipts, indexes, and physical recovery material.

tier_2_exception.admission: An admitted generator state plus exact reversible exceptions is smaller after complete protection than tier 3.
tier_2_exception.storage: Tier 1 material plus exact ordered exception positions and values.

tier_3_fallback.admission: Tier 1 and tier 2 are invalid or not smaller after full physical and metadata cost.
tier_3_fallback.storage: Raw canonical bytes plus manifests, roots, receipts, indexes, and physical recovery material.

admission_policy.selection: Evaluate tier 1, tier 2, and tier 3 deterministically; select the smallest complete protected representation among valid candidates.
admission_policy.tier1_requirement: A valid generator/domain witness and exact reconstruction.
admission_policy.tier2_requirement: Valid generator witness, exact reversible exceptions, and complete protected size strictly less than tier 3.
admission_policy.tier3_requirement: Always available for an exact-length canonical state.
admission_policy.replay_requirement: The same canonical input, predecessor set, and policy version must select the same tier and package bytes.
admission_policy.no_reference_vector_substitution: Reference ratios are ceilings or calibration points, not operating results.

integrity_and_recovery_gates: Exact full-state reconstruction for every admitted record.
Canonical state Hash216 equality before encode and after decode.
Deterministic tier classification and package replay.
No tier 1 admission without a generator witness.
No tier 2 admission without exact reversible exceptions.
Tier 3 fallback whenever semantic admission or size advantage fails.
One- and two-shard recovery within the declared Pass 212 stripe budget.
Fail closed beyond the declared physical recovery budget.
Historical corruption claims require independently retained minted anchors.
No floating-point authority in canonical metrics or identities.
iteration_1_nonclaims: No workload admission incidence has yet been measured.
No operating compression ratio has yet been established.
The 2546.93:1 and 590.58:1 values remain Pass 212 reference vectors.
No production telemetry deployment is claimed.
